notes:
Lead origin: inbound from blog post + quickstart; signed up with free credits and uploaded 3k sample tickets.

Needs / requirements (summary):
- Workload: ticket summarization for Tier1->Tier2 handoff, extraction of structured fields (customer, account, urgency, root_cause), and agent-assist (tool-calling to update ticket status).
- Latency: interactive agent flows target 200-500ms per token for short prompts; bulk summarization acceptable at 1-2s per request. Expect 5-20 rps during business hours, spike to ~40 rps during incidents.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, cost per 1k tokens is a gating factor; looking to stay <= $500/mo during pilot if accuracy hit.
- Model preferences: prefer small/medium open models for cost with fallback to higher-quality variants for complex tickets; interested in quantized variants and recommendations from Redwood Optimize.
- Routing/fallback: want transparent fallback to cheaper model if SLAs allow; need per-route cost/latency reporting in console.
- Security: SSO (SAML) is required for admin console; retention controls and audit logs for ticket edits. No on-prem requirement today (public cloud only).

Notes from call with Maya Ortiz (Head of Product):
- 'We need clean JSON outputs so our ticket automation rules can ingest without manual mapping.'
- 'If the hosted API is simple to wire up and costs stay low for the pilot, we'll convert to paid and expand to other queues.'

POC plan / success criteria:
- Deliver 90%+ acceptable summary on 1k production tickets (human-labeled eval)
- Structured output mapping to Zendesk fields with <5% schema errors
- Latency within 300ms median for chat-style agent prompts
- Cost under $500/mo for pilot scale (approx 100k tokens/mo)

Actions taken so far:
- Sent POC dataset instructions and api-keys quickstart (drive:/howto/noveo-poc-quickstart.md)
